scope: The same actual R74 long radial annulus: complete nonlinear Dirichlet solution, both trace outputs, full mean, and exact horizontal reconstruction. The nonlinear tail/body matching inverse is not asserted.

checks.name: two_lift_complete_norm

checks.evidence: The complete R25 root is used within its actual complex ball

checks.name: four_relative_state_coefficients

checks.name: holomorphic_source_lipschitz

checks.name: closed_ball_selfmap
